If the procedures are reported as global diagnostic procedures (i.e. without 26 or TC modifier) and with the same date of service, each procedure is split (for calculation purposes only) into the professional component (PC) and is given the 26 modifier and technical component (TC) and is given the TC modifier. If the procedures are reported with a TC modifier, the internal split does not happen. The procedures are then ranked by the calculated allowed amount of the TC component. The procedure with the highest rank will be reimbursed at 100% of its allowed amount and subsequent procedures will have the TC calculated at a defined TC percentage. If a split was performed, the professional component is added back to get the allowed amount for the procedure.
